column3: “By this” is rendered “on this condition,” and NASB supplies “it” (the covenant).
“Refrain for us” is rendered “Let us alone.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the ears of” is rendered “in the hearing of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “What is to the people” becomes “What is the matter with the people.”
“Rushed on Saul” is rendered “came upon Saul mightily,” and “his anger burned” as “he became very angry.”
“Like the heat of the sun” is rendered “by the time the sun is hot.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all the good in your eyes” becomes “whatever seems good to you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “deliver up the men” is rendered “Bring the men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “anyone” is rendered “not a man.”
